High, capture_tidewake_f13_5.gd --camera-set=T2-current (swim-away-day, swim-across-day, swim-away-night) --tidewake-current-candidate on both sides. base-High = main 05d86cec8 (arrow ON since #883) plus water_current_flow.gdshader and water_current_cue.gd at tb/newapproach 76c85cac4. arm-High = base plus NEWAPPROACH-T2B/overlay_t2b.json (current_flow.shader near_streak_opacity 0.5, range 38 m, lane 1.3 m, fill 0.4; water_current_cue strength_marks on, 0.6/1.2 m/s). Streaks follow the arrow in every view (along the view in both swim-away frames, left to right in swim-across), but they are long, hard-edged, ruler-straight white lines converging on the horizon, and in the distance they break into a ladder of dashes with T-shaped crossbars: they read as painted lane or running-track markings, not foam. Strength badge: a plate behind the arrow with three bars, one lit, on all three arm frames. Beach creatures differ between sides (wildlife placement, not the arm).
